test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In an election between two candidates, one person got 35% of the votes and lost by 6 votes. Assuming that there were no invalid votes, what was the total number of votes?
solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of votes received by losing candidate = 35%

Margin of loss = 6 votes

Calculation:

Let total votes = V

Votes received by losing candidate = 35% of V

Votes received by winning candidate = 65% of V

Margin = Votes received by winning candidate - Votes received by losing candidate

65% of V - 35% of V = 6

⇒ (65 - 35)% of&
nbsp;V = 6

⇒ 30% of V = 6

⇒ dfrac{30}{100} times V = 6

⇒ V = dfrac{6 times 100}{30}

⇒ V = 20

**∴ The total number of votes is 20.**
